payload.title: Vehicle Builder Socket Prep UX / 차량 메시 소켓 준비 UX
payload.next_action: VSPUX-P0-02: implement minimal Tab-local Quick Socket Prep for any selected StaticMesh. Show full existing Socket inventory across Wheel/Standard HP/Other (including unknown future naming), exact name/read-only Transform/copy/open Editor, mode-aware readback/refresh/return; dynamically populate supported Standard HP category picker from current VM category source and propose collision-free max+1 names with multiple independently placed sockets per category. Preserve current four Wheel role contract; ensure dynamic role name displayed=added/copied and legacy Step3/Recipe states unchanged. Unknown physical Socket does NOT automatically create Recipe/Runtime semantic binding; users can edit arbitrary custom sockets in existing StaticMesh Editor. No auto Save/Transform. Run focused/affected test, official UE 5.8 Source Build in P0-03. No Source/Asset/Automation was modified by the 2026-10-14 design correction.

provenance.resolution_basis: User expanded design requirement to support varied socket physical positions and future additional types. Review confirms current StandardHardpointCategories lists seven current values and parser accepts supplied category list; actual UStaticMesh owns arbitrary SocketName/Transform. Clarified full inventory, existing/other sockets, dynamic category selection and explicit downstream semantic contract, plus prior P1 quick view return/refresh/existing editing. Previous P0-01 v0.1.1 remains historical; v0.1.2 is reviewed correction. Design only, no UE source/assets/build/test/Git stage/commit/push.
